feedback.title: Feedback
feedback.description: Ratings your team gave to AI replies. Open any rating to see the reply in its conversation.

page.title: Insights
page.description: Patterns across your conversations and your team's ratings: what the AI gets wrong, what works, and what to change. Updated every night.

list.emptyDescription: Insights appear after the nightly analysis once a pattern shows up in at least {min} conversations. Positive patterns show up here too.
list.backfilling: Reviewing your conversations from the last 30 days. New insights will appear here after the analysis.

detail.evidenceHint: Short excerpts with personal data removed. Links open the conversation while it is still kept.
detail.paraphrases: What shoppers asked, in other words
detail.auditRecurred: The pattern came back after it was addressed
detail.rejectDescription: Tell us why, so the reason stays in the history. Nothing changes in your AI.

fixed.title: After it was addressed
fixed.watching: Watching: we compare the next {days} days with the 30 days before.
fixed.fixed: Fixed: {after} per week now, down from {before}.
fixed.improved: Improved: {after} per week now, down from {before}.
fixed.notFixed: Not fixed yet: {after} per week now, {before} before.

detail.archiveSuggestion: No new conversations for 45 days. You can archive this insight.

approve.hintPlaybook: Opens a suggested edit of the playbook for you to review. Saving it creates a draft; it only reaches new conversations after you publish it.
approve.hintKnowledge: Opens a suggested change to your knowledge for you to review before anything is saved.
approve.hintTask: This needs a change outside the AI. We keep it as a task here so you can track it.
approve.draftSaved: Draft saved. Publish the playbook to use it in new conversations.
approve.knowledgeSaved: Knowledge saved and insight marked as addressed
approve.taskDescription: Copy this into your task tracker, or keep it here. Mark the insight as addressed when it is done.

detail.auditApproved: Approved; a suggestion was opened for review

settingsDialog.title: Insights settings
settingsDialog.description: Starting values work for most stores. Changes apply from the next nightly analysis.
settingsDialog.minClusterSize: Minimum conversations before an insight appears
settingsDialog.digestEnabled: Weekly digest email to owners and admins
settingsDialog.tuning: In the last 30 days: {issues} reviewed conversations and ratings, {clusters} patterns, {promoted} shown, {singletons} seen only once.
